items.title: check rows record whether the process group outlived the command
items.implementation: Real-CLI lifecycle audit (coordinator request): exit-resolve returns at command exit (36ms for `( sleep 6 ) & echo done`, correct), over-cap kills the group with an honest marker, and spawn ENOENT fails fast. But a passing check's detached descendants are dropped from evidence AND from the sweep registry - `( sleep 6 )&` left pid 51915 running with no trace. Killing them would break legitimate cross-check helpers, so record group_alive via kill(-pgid,0) instead of dropping it silently.

acceptance_criteria.description: a check leaving a detached descendant records group_alive true; a clean check records false; held pipes do not mark timed_out
full factory suite green incl. timeout/UTF-8 controls

items.title: a throwing check fails the item instead of stranding it verifying
items.implementation: Real-CLI reproduction: a json-field check on a malformed target makes readJson throw, escaping cmdVerify entirely - the item stays 'verifying' with a bare verify-start, no check row, no verify-end, and later criteria never run, while a command-check failure records honest evidence and marks failed. Catch per-check exceptions and record them as failed check results so the transition completes.

acceptance_criteria.description: a malformed-JSON json-field check records a failed check row naming the parse error, marks the item failed, runs later criteria, and writes verify-end ok=false
full factory suite green

items.title: README progress-row fields list gains group_alive
items.implementation: FAC-154 added a new check-row field (group_alive: whether the check's process group outlived the command leader) but the README's progress-row enumeration predates it - the only evidence field absent from the operator-facing list.

acceptance_criteria.description: README progress-row description names group_alive
factory suite unaffected

items.title: alternate queues get isolated evidence subtrees under one root
items.implementation: Real-CLI reproduction: items/<id>.jsonl, evidence/, and deliveries/ were keyed by item id only, so two queues under one root with a same-id item silently mingled notes, checks, and bundles (both queues' IT-001 notes landed in one log). Non-default queues now get a self-contained runtime subtree queues/<token>/ (path-derived + hash suffix); the default queue keeps the root layout so all existing deliveries stay put, and run.lock stays global since it serializes the shared worktree too.

acceptance_criteria.description: same-id items in default and --backlog queues write separate item logs; alt evidence lands in one queues/ subtree; lock stays at root
full factory suite green (default-queue layout unchanged)

items.title: dry-run inner steps carry a deadline
items.implementation: The last unbounded spawned child: dry-run's inner spawnSync had no timeout, so a wedged inner step could pin the operator terminal forever. Now FACTORY_DRY_RUN_STEP_TIMEOUT_MS (default 120s) bounds each inner step; ETIMEDOUT is surfaced as 'step timed out' in the failure. README env-knob list updated.

acceptance_criteria.description: 1ms budget kills the first inner step with 'step timed out'; default deadline keeps dry-run green
full factory suite green
knob documented in the operator env list

items.title: README documents global options and queue isolation
items.implementation: Doc-surface gap: --root, --backlog, and --json existed in HELP/options but had zero README coverage, and FAC-157's queues/<token>/ isolation was undocumented. Added a Global options section covering all four flags (command-scoped flags referenced), the isolated-subtree semantics, and the shared run.lock; Layout bullet now lists run.lock/ and queues/.
